title: How to Book China's Bullet Trains as a Tourist in 2026 (Passport Only) | China Travel Expert
description:
You can book China's high-speed trains with just your passport — no Chinese bank account and no local phone number required.

Here's the short version for 2026: register on the official 12306 China Railway English app or site with your foreign passport. Tickets open exactly 15 days before departure (up to about 30 minutes before the train). Pay with Visa, Mastercard, JCB or Diners Club — or a linked Alipay/WeChat. You get an e-ticket; at the station you just tap your passport at the gate, no paper needed. Most passports verify automatically within minutes, but foreign names often go to a one-time manual review (a passport photo plus a selfie) that China State Railway says normally takes 3–5 working days — so register early. Trip.com is the easy alternative: it takes foreign cards and books the same trains for a small service fee.

🧭 Expert Tip: Do the 12306 identity verification a week before you need a ticket, not the morning of — the manual name check can take 3–5 working days and you can't buy until it clears.
